title: Localization of height-one residue factors
statement: Let B be a commutative Dedekind domain and let p and q belong to HeightOneSpectrum B. Put T = B \ q.asIdeal, R = Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal, and L = LocalizedModule T (B/p.asIdeal), with its canonical R-module structure. If p = q, then L is a nonzero simple R-module. If p ≠ q, then L is a subsingleton.
lean_statement: ∀ (B : Type*) [CommRing B] [IsDedekindDomain B] (p q : IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum B), (p = q → IsSimpleModule (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal) (LocalizedModule q.asIdeal.primeCompl (B ⧸ p.asIdeal))) ∧ (p ≠ q → Subsingleton (LocalizedModule q.asIdeal.primeCompl (B ⧸ p.asIdeal)))
